answer: Make influence scarce by auctioning a fixed number of action slots each epoch, where every identity may place one bid and must burn its bid whether it wins or not, so a relic of free-for-all access is replaced by price as the gate. A single honest agent pays once for a fair shot among competitors, while a sybil farmer must fund a burned bid for every copy to reach the zenith of the queue, and the cost of flooding the auction in a gale of fake bids exceeds any reward the copies could drain.
